partnerships: select p.{{id:partnerships}} as id, p.name, p.partner_type__label as partner_type, p.product_category, p.product_category__label as category, p.status, p.status__label as status_label, p.agreement_type__label as agreement, p.agreement_date, p.renewal_date, p.rationale, p.still_needed, p.value_to_us, p.owner__label as owner_name, (select c.name from associations a join companies c on c.pc_0011_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'partnerships' and a.other_object = 'companies' and a.record_id = p.{{id:partnerships}} order by c.name limit 1) as company, (select count(distinct d.pc_0012_id) from associations a join deals d on d.pc_0012_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'partnerships' and a.other_object = 'deals' and a.record_id = p.{{id:partnerships}}) as deals from partnerships p order by p.name
partnership_statuses: select api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = '{{code:partnerships}}' and property = 'status' and record_status = 'active' order by display_order
categories: select api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = '{{code:partnerships}}' and property = 'product_category' and record_status = 'active' order by display_order
integrations: select o.{{id:oem_integrations}} as id, o.name, o.integration_type__label as integration_type, o.status, o.priority, o.priority__label as priority_label, o.target_completion, o.go_live_date, o.next_steps, o.owner__label as owner_name, (select c.name from associations a join companies c on c.pc_0011_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'oem_integrations' and a.other_object = 'companies' and a.record_id = o.{{id:oem_integrations}} order by c.name limit 1) as company from oem_integrations o order by o.target_completion nulls last, o.name
integration_statuses: select api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = '{{code:oem_integrations}}' and property = 'status' and record_status = 'active' order by display_order
